python3 -c "
import re

with open('/root/runs/cost-verify-agent-rl/exp029_seed3_v2.log', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find all step lines with train metrics
pattern = r'step:(\d+) .*?train/AlfworldSG/success:([\d.]+).*?train/AlfworldSG/pass@8:([\d.]+).*?train/response_length:([\d.]+).*?actor/entropy:([\d.]+).*?actor/kl_loss:([\d.e+-]+).*?actor/pg_loss:([\d.e+-]+).*?actor/ppo_kl:([\d.e+-]+).*?actor/grad_norm:([\d.]+)'
matches = re.findall(pattern, content)

print('=== TRAIN METRICS PER STEP ===')
print(f'{\"Step\":>4} {\"Success\":>8} {\"Pass@8\":>8} {\"RespLen\":>10} {\"Entropy\":>8} {\"KL_Loss\":>12} {\"PG_Loss\":>14} {\"PPO_KL\":>12} {\"GradNorm\":>10}')
for m in matches:
    step, succ, p8, rl, ent, kl, pg, ppokl, gn = m
    print(f'{step:>4} {succ:>8} {p8:>8} {rl:>10} {ent:>8} {kl:>12} {pg:>14} {ppokl:>12} {gn:>10}')

# Find val metrics
val_pattern = r'step:(\d+) .*?val-env/AlfworldSG/success:([\d.]+).*?val-env/AlfworldSG/pass@1:([\d.]+).*?val-env/response_length:([\d.]+).*?val-core/unknown/reward/mean@32:([\d.]+)'
val_matches = re.findall(val_pattern, content)

print()
print('=== VAL METRICS ===')
print(f'{\"Step\":>4} {\"Val_Success\":>12} {\"Val_Pass@1\":>11} {\"Val_RespLen\":>12} {\"Val_Reward@32\":>14}')
for m in val_matches:
    step, succ, p1, rl, rwd = m
    print(f'{step:>4} {succ:>12} {p1:>11} {rl:>12} {rwd:>14}')

# Collapse metrics
collapse_pattern = r'step:(\d+) .*?collapse_first_turn_sample/mi_estimate:([\d.e+-]+)'
collapse_matches = re.findall(collapse_pattern, content)

print()
print('=== COLLAPSE MI_ESTIMATE PER STEP ===')
for m in collapse_matches:
    step, mi = m
    print(f'Step {step}: mi_estimate={mi}')

# critic score
critic_pattern = r'step:(\d+) .*?critic/score/mean:([\d.]+)'
critic_matches = re.findall(critic_pattern, content)
print()
print('=== CRITIC SCORE/MEAN ===')
for m in critic_matches:
    step, score = m
    print(f'Step {step}: critic/score/mean={score}')

import re

with open('/root/runs/cost-verify-agent-rl/exp029_seed3_v2.log', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Remove ANSI escape codes
content = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', content)

# Find all step lines
lines = content.split('\n')
step_lines = [l for l in lines if re.match(r'.*step:\d+ - ', l)]

for sl in step_lines:
    step_m = re.search(r'step:(\d+)', sl)
    if not step_m:
        continue
    step = step_m.group(1)
    
    # Extract key metrics
    metrics = {}
    for key in ['train/AlfworldSG/success', 'train/AlfworldSG/pass@8',
                'train/response_length', 'actor/entropy', 'actor/kl_loss',
                'actor/pg_loss', 'actor/ppo_kl', 'actor/grad_norm',
                'val-env/AlfworldSG/success', 'val-env/AlfworldSG/pass@1',
                'val-env/response_length', 'val-core/unknown/reward/mean@32',
                'collapse_first_turn_sample/mi_estimate',
                'critic/score/mean', 'response_length/mean']:
        pat = re.escape(key) + r':([-\d.e+]+)'
        m = re.search(pat, sl)
        if m:
            metrics[key] = m.group(1)
    
    print(f"--- Step {step} ---")
    for k, v in sorted(metrics.items()):
        print(f"  {k}: {v}")
    print()
